scripts.preinstall: [ "$NODE_ENV" = 'production' ] && echo '⚠️  NODE_ENV=production — devDependencies will be skipped. Run: unset NODE_ENV' >&2 || true
scripts.test: npm run packages:ensure && node scripts/with-source.mjs playwright test
scripts.drive: npm run packages:ensure && tsx scripts/drive-preflight.ts && PLAYWRIGHT_VISIBLE=1 E2E_SCREENSHOT_DIR=drive/screenshots E2E_REPORT_DIR=drive/results node scripts/with-source.mjs playwright test --config drive/playwright.config.ts
scripts.drive:serve: npm run packages:ensure && tsx scripts/drive-preflight.ts && PLAYWRIGHT_VISIBLE=1 E2E_SCREENSHOT_DIR=drive/screenshots E2E_REPORT_DIR=drive/results node scripts/with-source.mjs playwright test --config drive/engine.config.mts
scripts.test:smoke: npm run packages:ensure && node scripts/with-source.mjs playwright test tests/e2e/smoke
scripts.test:headed: npm run packages:ensure && PLAYWRIGHT_VISIBLE=1 node scripts/with-source.mjs playwright test
scripts.test:explorer: npm run packages:ensure && node scripts/with-source.mjs playwright test --ui
scripts.test:external-pack: npm run packages:ensure && tsx scripts/bounded.ts scenario bash tests/scripts/test-external-pack.sh
scripts.test:external-pack:contract: npm run packages:ensure && tsx scripts/bounded.ts suite bash tests/scripts/test-external-pack-contract.sh
scripts.test:packaged-authoring:author: tsx scripts/bounded.ts scenario bash tests/scripts/test-packaged-authoring-author.sh
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test
scripts.prebuild:be: npm run generate:entries -w @app/default-setup && npm run compile
scripts.compile: npm run packages:ensure && npm run build -w @app/default-setup
scripts.typecheck:fe: npm run type-check --workspace @app/renderer && echo '✅ Frontend type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:be: cd packages/api && npx tsc -p . --noEmit && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && npx tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && echo '✅ Backend type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:ears: npm run typecheck --workspace @abuddy/ears && echo '✅ EARS type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:sdk: npm run typecheck --workspace @abuddy/sdk && echo '✅ SDK type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:host: npm run typecheck --workspace @abuddy/host && echo '✅ Host type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:scripts: tsc -p scripts && tsc -p tests && tsc -p packages/repo-checks && tsc -p packages/publish-checks && echo '✅ Scripts, repo and publish checks, and E2E type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:ui: npm run typecheck --workspace @abuddy/ui && echo '✅ UI type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:main: npm run typecheck --workspace @app/main && echo '✅ Electron main type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:preload: npm run typecheck --workspace @app/preload && echo '✅ Preload type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:cli: npm run typecheck --workspace @abuddy/cli --workspace @abuddy/testing && echo '✅ CLI + testing type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:pack: npm run packages:ensure && npm run typecheck --workspace @app/default-setup && echo '✅ Default-setup pack type check passed'
scripts.api:update: npm run packages:ensure && npm run api:update -w @abuddy/ears -w @abuddy/sdk -w @abuddy/ui
